title: Put mini-dsh in front of programs and browsers
brief: Give mini-dsh its surfaces. Make every recorded event and every stream chunk observable, then build four thin layers over the same agent registry: a headless runner that runs one task and exits with a status code, a JSON-RPC server over stdio for an SDK client, an ACP bridge that answers the public protocol's methods, and a small web gateway that maps HTTP routes to remote methods. Each layer only translates; none of them changes the loop. When you finish, one agent can be driven from a shell script, from another program and from a browser.

starter.note: Emit agent/assistant-stream frames: start before the first chunk, one chunk frame per stream chunk, end with the seq of the committed assistant/message or none.
watch(ctx, agent, show): listens on session/event and agent/assistant-stream and returns one disposer for both.
runHeadless(ctx, task): fresh session-<uuid> agent, reasoning to stderr, final text to stdout, exit 0 only on a completed last turn.
LineTransport: splits input at newlines, answers requests by id, sends notifications, turns a thrown handler into error -32603.
initialize, session/prompt, session/wait, shutdown; forwards every session/event as a session.event notification.
initialize, session/new, session/prompt (answers at turn end with stopReason), session/cancel, and session/update notifications.
node:http on 127.0.0.1:4100: POST /api/<namespace>/<method> with {args}, and GET /api/session/follow as server-sent events.

hints: Register both listeners in watch() before you return, and return one function that calls both disposers, so a closed screen leaves nothing behind.
In the headless runner, keep agent.session.seq before the followup and fold only the events after it; a resumed session must not lend an old completed turn to this run.
Standard output belongs to the protocol in the SDK server and the ACP bridge. Send every log line to standard error.
In the ACP bridge, keep a set of sessions with an open prompt and refuse a second prompt for the same session instead of queueing it.
For the follow stream, send the events already in the record first and attach the live listener in the same synchronous block, so no event falls between them.

rubric.criterion: Every appended event goes out as session/event, and every chunk goes out as a frame that ends by naming the committed message or none
The runner prints only the final text on stdout, reasoning on stderr, and exits 0 only when the last turn in its own interval completed
Requests get responses with the same id, notifications get none, invalid lines are ignored, and a failed handler answers -32603
session/prompt answers only at turn end, maps max-tokens to max_tokens and interrupted to cancelled, and allows one open prompt per session
Only listed remote methods answer under /api/, other paths get 404, and the follow stream sends the record before live events

milestones.title: Two channels a screen can follow
milestones.body: Add the three frame types to src/loop.ts and write src/watch.ts. Write test/watch.test.ts with a real DeepSeek call: ask for a one-sentence answer, collect what watch() shows, and assert that the text from the chunk frames equals the text of the committed assistant/message and that the end frame names its seq.

milestones.title: A headless runner with an honest exit code
milestones.body: Write src/headless.ts as a profile entry point that reads the task from argv. Print the final text on stdout and return the exit code from the last turn/end reason in the run's own events. Try a tiny max_tokens setting and confirm the code becomes 1.
milestones.checkCmd: npx tsx src/headless.ts "Reply with the single word ok" && echo exit-0

milestones.title: JSON-RPC over stdio
milestones.body: Write src/rpc.ts and src/sdk-server.ts. In test/rpc.test.ts, drive the transport through two PassThrough streams: an initialize request, a session/prompt request, one invalid line, and an unknown method. Assert the response ids, at least one session.event notification, no answer to the invalid line, and error -32603 for the unknown method.

milestones.title: An ACP bridge on the same transport
milestones.body: Write src/acp.ts over LineTransport. In test/acp.test.ts, create a session, send a prompt, and assert that tool_call, tool_call_update and agent_message_chunk updates arrive before the response, that the response carries stopReason end_turn, and that a second prompt sent while the first is open is refused.

milestones.title: A web gateway with a follow stream
milestones.body: Write src/web.ts with a remote() table and a generated client stub file in web/client.ts. Start the server, call POST /api/session/prompt through the stub, open GET /api/session/follow, and assert that the stream starts with the recorded events, then shows turn/end. Assert that POST /api/session/delete gets 404.
